name: ai-business-tools
description: Connect Claude Code to your ai-business-tools workspace — invoices, clients, projects, expenses, estimates, transactions, and more, all through the workspace's MCP server.

AIBT_URL.description: Base URL of your ai-business-tools deployment (e.g. https://agent.onit.systems). No trailing slash. Full API docs at <AIBT_URL>/docs.

AIBT_API_KEY.description: API key generated at <AIBT_URL>/admin#api (Settings → API). Format: aibt_<role>_<random>. The key's role (read/write/admin) determines which tools you can call.
